why: The fork's turns dance on their own before the note sounds, so the motion carries the idea and the note only keeps its pulse.

veto.quote: mushy timing; movement that decorates instead of saying something; clutter on stage
veto.why: A figure dancing in the corner while someone paints is movement that decorates the one stage where the painting must be seen.

style: Every pet keeps time to a clear pulse, each gesture landing on the beat and no motion wasted.
making: Each sprite needs the same frame rate and beat count per cycle, so the shared style sheet should fix timing as well as look.
